shortBio.en: Sex Pistols guitarist; brickwall power chords on the 1976–77 singles.
shortBio.zh: Sex Pistols 吉他手；1976–77 单曲上的砖墙强力和弦。

body.en:
Born 1955. Supplies the high-gain chord wall on Anarchy, God Save the Queen, Pretty Vacant. Often covers bass on records when Vicious tenure is unstable.

Post-Pistols: solo and session work; instrumental constant of the short catalog.
body.zh:
1955 年生。在 Anarchy、God Save the Queen、Pretty Vacant 上提供高增益和弦墙。Vicious 任期不稳时唱片上常顶贝斯。

Pistols 后：独唱与录音室工作；短目录的器乐常量。
